title: Credit Policy Schedule of Underwriting Thresholds for the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan
content:
**Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan — underwriting thresholds by tier.** Each tier of the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan sets the following figures:

- **Tenure:** days of employment with the sponsoring employer required to apply (days).
- **Paychecks:** paychecks from the employer required before applying (count).
- **Age:** minimum borrower age (years).
- **Principal ceiling:** principal ceiling as percent of the worker's annualized gross pay (percent).
- **Installment ceiling:** ceiling on one installment as percent of the worker's average net pay per period (percent).
- **Earned Wage Access balance limit:** the Earned Wage Access balance above which an application is not approved (USD).
- **Earned Wage Access write-off look-back:** calendar days before the application within which an Earned Wage Access write-off declines the application (days).

| Tier | Tenure | Paychecks | Age | Principal ceiling | Installment ceiling | Earned Wage Access balance limit | Write-off look-back |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | 90 days | 4 | 18 years | 8% of annualized gross pay | 15% of average net pay per period | $100.00 | 180 calendar days |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 90 days | 4 | 18 years | 8% | 15% | $150.00 | 180 calendar days |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | 180 days | 6 | 18 years | 8% | 15% | $250.00 | 180 calendar days |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | 180 days | 6 | 18 years | 8% | 15% | $300.00 | 180 calendar days |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | 365 days | 8 | 18 years | 8% | 15% | $400.00 | 180 calendar days |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | 365 days | 8 | 18 years | 8% | 15% | $500.00 | 180 calendar days |

The tenure and paycheck figures are the tier's entry gate. They rise with the principal band: 90 days and 4 paychecks for the two smallest bands, 180 days and 6 paychecks for the middle two, 365 days and 8 paychecks for the two largest. The age, ceiling and look-back figures are the same in every tier.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- A worker with a hypothetical annualized gross pay of $26000.00: 8% of that pay is $2080.00, the principal ceiling for that worker.
- A worker whose hypothetical average net pay per period is $700.00: 15% of that pay is $105.00, the ceiling on one installment.
- Tenure against a 180-day requirement: 180 days of employment meets it; 179 days does not.
- Paychecks against a 6-paycheck requirement: 6 paychecks meets it; 5 does not.
- Earned Wage Access balance against a $250.00 limit: a balance of $250.00 is not above the limit; a balance of $250.01 is above it.
